title: Taiwan East Coast EV Road Trip: Taroko Gorge to Taitung & Kenting — Complete 7-Day Itinerary 2026
excerpt: Discover Taiwan's stunning east coast by electric car — from the marble cliffs of Taroko Gorge down the Huadong Valley to Taitung, and around the southern tip to Kenting National Park. Complete charging guide, hotel recommendations, costs, and essential EV tips for Taiwan's most scenic route.
author: EV Charging Asia
content:
## Taiwan East Coast EV Road Trip: Taroko to Kenting

Taiwan's east coast is one of Asia's most spectacular drives — the **Su Hua Highway** (Highway 9) hugging towering coastal cliffs, the **Huadong Valley** rice paddies stretching to the Pacific, and the tropical beaches of **Kenting National Park** at the island's southern tip. And in 2026, this 550 km route is fully EV-ready.

This guide covers the complete 7-day east coast loop from Taipei: **Taroko Gorge → Hualien → Taitung → Kenting**, with full charging details for every leg, EV-friendly hotels, cost breakdowns, and practical tips for driving Taiwan's most beautiful coastline in an electric car.

## Overview: The 7-Day East Coast Loop

| Day | Route | Distance | Driving Time | Highlights |
|-----|-------|----------|-------------|-----------|
| 1 | Taipei → Hualien (via Highway 9) | 180 km | 3 hours | Qingshui Cliffs, Shakadang Trail, Qixingtan Beach |
| 2 | Taroko Gorge exploration | — | — | Swallow Grotto, Eternal Spring Shrine, Tunnel of Nine Turns |
| 3 | Hualien → Taitung (Huadong Valley) | 170 km | 3.5 hours | Rift Valley, Chishang rice paddies, hot springs |
| 4 | Taitung exploration | — | — | Taitung Forest Park, Jialulan Coast, night markets |
| 5 | Taitung → Kenting | 110 km | 2.5 hours | Taiwan's southern tip passing Eluanbi Lighthouse |
| 6 | Kenting exploration | — | — | Kenting beaches, ocean activities, night market |
| 7 | Kenting → Taipei (via Highway 1) | 370 km | 5 hours | High-speed charging stops at Taichung or Hsinchu |
| **Total** | **Round trip** | **~830 km** | **~16 hours** | |

## Taiwan's EV Charging Ecosystem

Taiwan has one of Asia's most comprehensive EV charging networks, driven by aggressive government policy and the dominance of **Luxgen** (Taiwan's homegrown EV maker) and **Tesla**. Key operators:

| Network | Charger Types | Coverage | App |
|---------|-------------|----------|-----|
| **Noodoe** | AC + DC (50-120 kW) | Island-wide, 800+ stations | Noodoe EV |
| **Tesla Supercharger** | V3 250 kW | Major highways + city centers | Tesla app |
| **YES! Energy** | DC (60-180 kW) | Hotels, highway rest stops | YES! Charger |
| **EValue** | DC (60-150 kW) | City hubs, shopping malls | EValue |
| **TailPower** | DC (50-120 kW) | Government buildings, tourist spots | TailPower |
| **Luxgen** | AC + DC (50-100 kW) | Luxgen service centers island-wide | Luxgen+ |

**Connector types**: Taiwan uses **CCS2** (most common for DC fast charging) and **Type 2** (AC). Tesla uses its proprietary connector at Superchargers but most destination chargers have Tesla Wall Connectors or J1772 adapters.

**Payment**: All major apps accept credit cards. Noodoe supports Line Pay and EasyCard (contactless). Most chargers are app-activated, though some Tesco-branded stations accept tap-to-pay at newer installations.

## Day 1: Taipei → Hualien (180 km)

Leave Taipei via the **Taipei-Yilan Expressway (Highway 5)** through the Hsuehshan Tunnel — at 12.9 km, Taiwan's longest road tunnel. Charge in **Yilan** at the **Luna Plaza** Noodoe station (60 kW DC) before tackling the spectacular Su Hua Highway.

### Charging on the Su Hua Highway

| Location | Distance from Taipei | Charger | Speed | Notes |
|----------|---------------------|---------|-------|-------|
| Luna Plaza (Yilan) | 50 km | Noodoe DC | 60 kW | 4 stalls, large food court |
| Nanfangao Rest Stop | 75 km | YES! Energy DC | 60 kW | New in 2025, ocean views |
| Heping Rest Area | 120 km | Tesla Supercharger | 250 kW | 8 V3 stalls, mountain backdrop |
| Taroko (entrance) | 170 km | Noodoe AC | 22 kW | Near Taroko gate, hotel zone |
| Hualien City | 180 km | Multiple (see below) | Varied | Best to charge overnight |

### The Su Hua Highway Experience

The **Highway 9** from Su'ao to Hualien is Taiwan's most famous coastal road. The newly upgraded Su'ao-Hualien section (completed 2020) features dramatic tunnels and bridges carved into the cliffs, with the Pacific Ocean on one side and the Central Mountain Range on the other. The **Qingshui Cliffs** viewpoint (at the 154 km marker) is unmissable — turquoise waters crashing against 800-meter marble cliffs.

### EV Charging in Hualien

| Location | Charger Type | Speed | Operator | Address |
|----------|-------------|-------|----------|---------|
| Far Eastern Mall Hualien | DC + AC | 60 kW + 22 kW | Noodoe | No. 128, Linsen Road |
| TSUTAYA BOOKSTORE Hualien | DC | 60 kW | YES! Energy | Near Hualien Station |
| Hualien Tesla Supercharger | V3 | 250 kW | Tesla | Near Dongdamen Night Market |
| Silks Place Taroko (hotel) | AC | 22 kW | Noodoe | Inside Taroko National Park |
| Hotel de Hualien | Tesla Wall Conn. | 11 kW | — | Miyuan District |

**Best charging stop on arrival**: The **Far Eastern Mall** in central Hualien has 4 Noodoe DC fast chargers (60 kW) in the parking lot. Charge while having dinner at the nearby Dongdamen Night Market — Taiwan's largest night market east of Taipei.

## Day 2: Taroko Gorge Exploration

Taroko Gorge National Park is Taiwan's answer to the Grand Canyon — a 19 km marble-walled canyon carved by the Liwu River. It's best explored over a full day.

### Charging in Taroko

| Charging Spot | Location | Charger | Speed |
|--------------|----------|---------|-------|
| Silks Place Taroko | Hotel entrance | AC Level 2 | 22 kW |
| Taroko Visitor Center | Park entrance | AC Level 2 | 7 kW |
| Shakadang Trail parking | Trailhead | AC Level 2 | 7 kW |
| Tianxiang Recreation Area | Mid-canyon | AC Level 2 | 22 kW |

> **Tip**: Charge overnight at your Hualien hotel or at Silks Place Taroko if you're staying inside the park. The canyon driving is short (30 km round trip from the entrance to Tianxiang) but elevation changes (~500m) mean you'll consume more battery than expected.

### Must-See Stops in Taroko

| Stop | Distance from Entrance | Time Needed | Why Go |
|------|----------------------|-------------|--------|
| Shakadang Trail | 1 km | 1.5 hours | Crystal-clear turquoise river, marble boulders |
| Swallow Grotto Trail | 7 km | 1 hour | Walkway carved into cliff face, swallow nests |
| Tunnel of Nine Turns | 10 km | 45 min | The trail along marble cliffs (closed in typhoons) |
| Changchun Shrine | 3 km | 30 min | Iconic waterfall temple |
| Baiyang Waterfall Trail | 18 km | 2 hours | 3 tunnels, 2 suspension bridges, waterfall finale |
| Xiangde Temple | 12 km | 20 min | Temple with sweeping canyon views |

## Day 3: Hualien → Taitung — Huadong Valley (170 km)

This is the heart of Taiwan's east coast. The **Huadong Valley** (Hua-Tung) runs along the eastern Rift Valley between the Central and Coastal mountain ranges. You'll pass rice paddies, hot springs, and indigenous villages.

### Route: Highway 9 (Mountain Side)

The inland **Highway 9** route is the flatter, more direct option with better charging infrastructure.

| Segment | Distance | Charging Stop | Charger |
|---------|----------|--------------|---------|
| Hualien → Guangfu | 45 km | 7-Eleven Guangfu | Noodoe AC 22 kW |
| Guangfu → Ruisui | 25 km | Ruisui Hot Springs area | YES! Energy DC 60 kW |
| Ruisui → Yuli | 20 km | Yuli Train Station | EValue DC 60 kW |
| Yuli → Chishang | 15 km | Chishang / Mr. Brown Avenue | TailPower AC 22 kW |
| Chishang → Taitung | 65 km | Taitung City (destination) | Multiple (see below) |

### Route Alternative: Highway 11 (Coastal Side)

If you have time, the coastal Highway 11 from Hualien to Taitung is 20 km longer but absolutely stunning — cliffs, black sand beaches, and the **Shitiping** rock formations.

| Charging Spot on HWY 11 | Distance from Hualien | Charger |
|------------------------|---------------------|---------|
| 7-Eleven Shoufong | 25 km | Noodoe AC 22 kW |
| Farglory Ocean Park | 35 km | Noodoe DC 60 kW |
| Shitiping Scenic Area | 65 km | YES! Energy AC 22 kW |
| Dulan Village | 110 km | TailPower DC 60 kW |
| Jialulan Coast | 130 km | Noodoe AC 22 kW |

### Top Stops on the Huadong Valley

- **Mr. Brown Avenue** (Chishang) — Taiwan's most photographed road: a country lane lined with rice paddies, framed by mountains. Best at sunrise or late afternoon.
- **Ruisui Hot Springs** — Soak in iron-rich hot springs after a day of driving. EV charging available at the Ruisui Hot Spring Park.
- **Lintianshan Forestry Center** — A preserved Japanese-era logging town with historic railways and forest walks.
- **Dafu (Fata'an) Indigenous Village** — Amis indigenous cultural center with traditional music and bamboo dance performances.

## Day 4: Taitung Exploration

Taitung City is the east coast's cultural and transport hub. With a relaxed, artsy vibe and stunning coastal scenery, it's worth a full day.

### Charging in Taitung

| Location | Charger | Speed |
|----------|---------|-------|
| Taitung Tesla Supercharger | V3 | 250 kW |
| Taitung Train Station | TailPower DC | 60 kW |
| Far Eastern Mall Taitung | Noodoe DC + AC | 60 kW + 22 kW |
| Taitung Sugar Factory | EValue AC | 22 kW |
| The GAYA Hotel | Tesla Wall Connector | 11 kW |

### Top Taitung Attractions

- **Taitung Forest Park** — Massive urban park with lakes, bike trails, and the famous Papaya Lake (framed for perfect sunrise photos).
- **Tiehua Village** — Creative arts district in old railway dormitories. Weekend music markets (Fri-Sun evening) are fantastic.
- **Jialulan Coast** — Just 15 km north of Taitung, this artsy beach area has driftwood sculptures, a coastal boardwalk, and small cafes.
- **Luye High-Terrace** — At sunset, this plateau offers panoramic views of the Huadong Valley. Famous for hot air balloon season (May-August).
- **Taitung Night Market** — More local than Taipei's equivalents. Try the grilled mountain boar, wild greens, and pineapple cakes.

## Day 5: Taitung → Kenting (110 km)

The final push south takes you past Taiwan's southern tip at Eluanbi, where the Pacific meets the Taiwan Strait and the Bashi Channel.

### Route: South-Link Highway 9 + HWY 26

| Segment | Distance | Charging |
|---------|----------|----------|
| Taitung → Daren | 45 km | EValue DC (60 kW) at Daren Rest Stop |
| Daren → Fangliao | 15 km | YES! Energy DC (60 kW) at Fangliao |
| Fangliao → Kenting (via HWY 26) | 50 km | Kenting Tesla Supercharger (destination) |

### Taiwan's Southern Tip Route

The South-Link Highway (HWY 9 from Taitung to Fangliao) crosses the coastal mountains with stunning ocean views. At **Shouka**, look for the indigenous Paiwan tribe's villages with traditional slate houses. The **Fangliao** area marks the transition from east coast cliffs to the tropical south.

Once on HWY 26 heading south, you're on Taiwan's version of the Great Ocean Road. The road hugs the coast past Hengchun's historic town walls and opens onto the tropical Kenting coast.

### Kenting Charging

| Location | Charger | Speed | Notes |
|----------|---------|-------|-------|
| Kenting Tesla Supercharger | V3 | 250 kW | 6 stalls at Kenting Street entrance |
| Howard Beach Resort Kenting | Noodoe DC | 60 kW | Guest access + DC fast |
| Chateau Beach Resort Kenting | YES! Energy DC | 60 kW | Beachfront, public access |
| Kenting Night Market Parking | AC Level 2 | 22 kW | Charge while you eat |
| Hengchun City (nearby) | Multiple | 22-60 kW | 4 stations in town |

### EV-Friendly Hotels in Kenting

| Hotel | Area | Charger | Speed | Notes |
|-------|------|---------|-------|-------|
| Howard Beach Resort | Kenting Beach | Noodoe DC + AC | 60 kW + 22 kW | Best EV facility in area |
| Chateau Beach Resort | Kenting Beach | YES! DC | 60 kW | Public access near main beach |
| Caesar Park Hotel | Kenting Beach | Tesla Wall Connect | 11 kW | Luxury option |
| Kenting Youth Activity Center | Near Kenting | Noodoe AC | 22 kW | Budget-friendly |
| Hotelday+ Kenting | Kenting Street | AC Level 2 | 7 kW | Central location, night market |

## Day 6: Kenting Exploration

Kenting National Park is Taiwan's southernmost tropical paradise — coral beaches, hiking trails, and an electric night market.

### Top Kenting Stops

| Attraction | Type | Time Needed | Notes |
|-----------|------|-------------|-------|
| Kenting Main Beach | Swimming | 2-4 hours | White sand, calm winter waters |
| Eluanbi Lighthouse | Historic | 1 hour | Taiwan's southernmost point, lighthouse |
| Longpan Park | Coast walk | 1.5 hours | Cliff-top walk, incredible views |
| Chuanfanshih (Sail Rock) | Beach | 1 hour | Iconic sail-shaped coral reef |
| Houbihu Harbor | Seafood | 1.5 hours | Fresh catch, fishing harbor views |
| Kenting Night Market | Food | 2 hours | 500+ food stalls on Kenting Street |
| Maobitou Park | Coastal | 1 hour | Coral coast, hiking trails |

### Charging Tip for Kenting

DC fast charging in Kenting is concentrated at the Tesla Supercharger and resort DC stations. **Charge at Howard Beach Resort** if you're staying there, or use the **Kenting Tesla Supercharger** (arrive before 11am on weekends to avoid queues during peak summer season).

## Day 7: Kenting → Taipei (370 km)

The return leg is a long drive up Taiwan's west coast Highway 1 or Highway 3.

### Recommended Charging Stops (Kenting → Taipei)

| Stop | Distance from Kenting | Charger | Speed | Notes |
|------|---------------------|---------|-------|-------|
| Fangshan Rest Area | 35 km | Noodoe DC | 60 kW | First stop after leaving Kenting |
| Kaohsiung (Zuoying) | 110 km | Tesla Supercharger + YES! Energy | 250 kW / 180 kW | Major charging hub, lunch stop |
| Tainan Rest Area | 170 km | EValue DC | 150 kW | Historical city, 15-min top-up |
| Taichung (Xitun) | 260 km | Multiple DC stations | 60-250 kW | Best lunch stop if you skipped Tainan |
| Hsinchu | 320 km | YES! Energy DC | 180 kW | Science Park area, high-tech charging |
| Taipei (arrival) | 370 km | — | — | Charge on arrival at home/destination |

### Optional: West Coast Detours

- **Kaohsiung** — Taiwan's second city has the magnificent **Fo Guang Shan** Buddha Museum, **Pier-2 Art Center**, and the **Love River** night walk.
- **Tainan** — Taiwan's oldest city with 300+ temples and the best street food on the island. **Anping Tree House** and **Chihkan Tower** are must-sees.
- **Taichung** — The **Rainbow Village**, **Fengjia Night Market**, and the flower art at **Zhongshe Flower Market**.

## Total Cost Breakdown

### Assuming a BYD Atto 3 (50 kWh battery) or similar mid-range EV

| Item | Cost (TWD) | Cost (USD) |
|------|-----------|-----------|
| DC Fast Charging (6 sessions × 30 kWh) | 1,080 TWD | ~$33 USD |
| AC Destination Charging (6 nights) | 0-600 TWD | $0-18 USD (often free) |
| **Total Charging** | **~1,000-1,700 TWD** | **~$33-52 USD** |
| Highway Tolls (full loop) | ~500 TWD | ~$15 USD |
| Hotels (7 nights, mid-range with EV charging) | 21,000 TWD | ~$650 USD |
| Meals (7 days, street food + casual restaurants) | 5,600 TWD | ~$170 USD |
| **Total Trip Cost** | **~28,000 TWD** | **~$870 USD** |

> **Savings vs petrol car**: A similar trip in a petrol car would cost approximately 3,500-4,500 TWD ($108-140 USD) in fuel — EVs save roughly 60-70% on energy costs even when using paid DC fast charging.

## Family-Friendly Tips

1. **Kids' activities** — Taroko's Shakadang Trail is easy for children (flat, 2 km return). Kenting's main beach has gentle waves. The Huadong Valley has farm visits at **Dafu** where kids can feed goats and ride ponies.

2. **Stroller accessibility** — Taroko's Tunnel of Nine Turns has a one-way pedestrian walkway suitable for strollers (with steep bits). Most malls and rest stops have elevator access.

3. **Timing** — Avoid Typhoon season (July-October) for the east coast. The Su Hua Highway is prone to rockslides and closures during heavy rain. **Best months: March-May and November-December**. Spring (April) is perfect for Taroko's cherry blossoms and comfortable temperatures.

4. **Car seats** — Taiwan law requires child safety seats for children under 4 (under 18 kg). Rental EV providers like **IWS** and **Car+** offer car seat rentals. Book in advance.

5. **Charging with kids** — Use AC destination charging at hotels overnight so you start each day with a full battery. The Huadong Valley route has 7-Eleven and FamilyMart convenience store charging — perfect for bathroom breaks and snacks.

6. **Emergency charging** — Download the **Noodoe EV, YES! Charger, and EValue** apps before leaving Taipei. Most 7-Eleven stores along the east coast have basic AC charging (slow but available).

## Must-Have Apps for Taiwan EV Road Trips

| App | Purpose | Notes |
|-----|---------|-------|
| Noodoe EV | Find & activate chargers | Most stations, accepts credit card + Line Pay |
| YES! Charger | DC fast charging | Hotels + highway rest stops |
| EValue | DC + AC charging | Growing urban network |
| Google Maps | Navigation | Accurate for EV charging POI if imported |
| PlugShare | Community charger map | Good for finding hidden hotel chargers |
| Taiwan e-Tag App | Toll payment | Top-up for highway tolls |
| Weather (Central Weather Bureau) | Storm tracking | Essential during typhoon season |

## Verdict: Is Taiwan's East Coast Ready for EVs?

**Absolutely.** Taiwan's east coast is arguably THE most underrated EV road trip destination in Asia. The combination of well-spaced DC fast charging (every 30-60 km), excellent hotel destination charging (especially at mid-range+ hotels), and short leg distances (maximum 180 km between major cities) means **range anxiety is minimal**.

The Noodoe and YES! Energy networks are reliable, have well-maintained chargers, and customer support is responsive via their apps. Even along the remote Huadong Valley, you're never more than 40 km from a charging point.

What makes Taiwan special is what's at each stop: **world-class national parks, thermal hot springs, indigenous culture, seafood straight from the Pacific, and some of Asia's most welcoming family-run accommodations**.

For 2026, the east coast charging gap has been fully closed. The only remaining challenge is the Su Hua Highway's limited charging during peak season, but the newly expanded Heping Tesla Supercharger (8 stalls) largely solves this.

> **Bottom line**: If you want one EV road trip in Asia that combines dramatic scenery, cultural depth, and absolute driving pleasure — Taiwan's east coast is the answer. The 7-day Taroko-to-Kenting loop is perfectly paced for EV charging and delivers some of the most memorable days you'll have on four wheels.
